job: Repair the Shine V4 public landing page before-and-after comparison so it shows related, truthful screenshots of the real V3 and V4 pages at matched viewport and crop, then verify the interaction and deployed presentation
primaryTask: Compare the actual V3 and V4 public pages side by side and understand what the rebuild materially changed.

defects.problem: The evidence action promises a rebuild but reveals a real V3 screenshot beside an abstract placeholder, so the user cannot perform the promised comparison.
defects.evidence: The V3 figure contains site/img/shine-v3-before.png; the V4 figure contains only .after-visual, four empty .line elements, and no screenshot.
defects.expectedEffect: Reveal two real page captures at the same 16:10 frame so the comparison can be completed directly.

defects.problem: The V4 comparison figure has no source artifact, intrinsic dimensions, or descriptive screenshot alternative text.
defects.evidence: The After panel is a role=img div whose accessible name admits it is an abstraction rather than the claimed rebuild screenshot.
defects.expectedEffect: Use the checked-in V4 browser capture with explicit dimensions and a truthful description.

defects.problem: The two comparison panels use different visual grammars: a dense white page capture versus a sparse green decorative card.
defects.evidence: The baseline screenshot shows the left panel as a recognizable webpage and the right panel as a geometric illustration with no matching page chrome or content regions.
defects.expectedEffect: Use the same image frame, crop position, and screenshot treatment for both versions.

defects.problem: The placeholder resembles a skeleton card and reads as unfinished work inside the page's principal proof section.
defects.evidence: Four unlabeled horizontal bars inside a tilted box are the only content in the After frame.
defects.expectedEffect: Remove the placeholder-only CSS and let the actual V4 composition carry the visual proof.
